question: Does a full GNN proposal improve the live quality versus CPU decision-time frontier of an existing MP-OFF plus hand selector?

design.seed_selection: First eight coverage-eligible seeds in 10301..10340, no outcomes read
design.selector: Frozen deterministic base-plus-queue score, coefficient 1, name tie-break

metrics.quality: Live mean elapsed seconds per task, topology as paired unit
metrics.cost: Measured total CPU inference seconds / completed tasks; report median and per-topology values
metrics.candidate_diversity: Distinct plan count and selection frequency within each live arm; diagnostic only

pass_rule: GNN is useful at this recipe only if its median paired quality gain is >=2% and positive on >=7/8 topologies versus each control whose median measured CPU cost is no greater than GNN. A slower arm is reported on the quality-time frontier but is not a time-feasible control. No message-passing-specific claim follows from a pass.
audit: 160 complete groups and 5120 tasks per arm
complete selector trace with all candidate plans
